scope: Native direct-input List capture, staged destinations, per-List preference isolation and membership navigation
qualificationPolicy: Select eight unchanged capture regressions from each initial run and both List journeys from each final followup. Initial List outcomes, including passing phone outcomes, are excluded. The product code is identical in both runs; only the new List test helpers changed for toolbar overflow. This does not claim that the initial tablet run passed.

reviews.standards: No remaining confirmed findings; final source, artifacts and split-run qualification verified.
reviews.spec: No remaining confirmed findings; final requirements, selected actual outcomes and open gates verified.
